stopped.admission: V_SEQ melodic part,ui.rec1,seq.playing0. PARA plays but does not start a new step-record onset.
stopped.cursor: REC-on resets selected melodic ui.wpos to0. Every mono note/rest/tie writes wpos%len then advances modulo len. Entry order is forward indices regardless of playback direction. No auto-length extension.
stopped.velocity: Each stopped note stores100. Chord root also stores100. Physical hold duration is not captured here;gate uses legacy authored form with endpoint nibble0.
stopped.notes: Mono each accepted down writes a note;CHORD-held adds ACCENT,NOTE_REPEAT-held adds SLIDE. CHORD+eitherOCTAVE writes REST;NOTE_REPEAT+eitherOCTAVE writes TIE and consumes modifier release.
stopped.chords: Available poly kind stores up to6 sorted unique pitches. First onset advances once;additional keydowns while keys remain held can replace/extend that same recorded chord cell. Releasing all then a fresh onset advances next cell. A key release alone is not a universal stopped-chord commit event.
stopped.overwrite: Only visited cells are replaced;rearming is not a new take object or automatic erasure of the whole pattern.

running.admission: Current melodic V_SEQ mask andui.rec;FWD/REV only. External channels/masks are separate current paths. A pre-held press does not become a fresh recorded onset merely by arming.
running.quantisation: Nearest actual playing step:half-step decision uses swung internal span or accepted external tick state. Before first step,FWD targets0 andREV targetslen−1.
running.velocity: Panel bass_kbd submits100 toengine_bass_record. External MIDI can submit incoming velocity;do not generalise it to physical panel capture.
running.duration: Accepted onset writesNOTE and endpoint15;held continuation writesTIE. Release finalises last cell endpoint1..15 (1/15 of current slot,plus block/input batching). Periodic capture saturates one traversal;no extra loop count.
running.direction: PINGPONG/RANDOM refuse before pattern write and emitREC NEEDS FWD/REV. Audition/transport can remain;heard is not recorded.
running.chords: Poly held-set changes are distinct recorder onsets;unchanged held set does not re-record. >6/failed chord allocation emitsCHORD NOT SAVED;note-lock capture refusal emitsNOTE SOUND NOT SAVED.
running.lifecycle: REC-off/STOP/clear/target-pattern or admission change finalises/cancels original recorder owner. Generation/epoch gates prevent stale queued REC commands and old releases adopting a new take.

correction.route: REC off,FreePlayoff,V_SEQ,page containing existing target. Hold original white step ≥300ms;read stored STEP/note/V100;OCTAVE+ adds12semitones exactly;release original owner. Short unedited existing-step tap <300ms deletes it.
correction.knobs: While held K2=probability,K3=velocity1..127,K5=note,K6=REST/NOTE/TIE cycle,K7=accent toggle,K8=slide toggle. K6 reconstructs flags and clears captured endpoint nibble;it is a gate correction,not duration preservation.
